assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent raster game background layer for NEON OVERDRIVE CYCLONE, skyline-far. Subject: distant floating atmospheric stations and storm-harvesting towers, thin antenna spires. Fine crisp pixel art with deliberate clusters at about 360 virtual pixels across, no chunky blocks, not photorealistic. Palette: near-black navy and teal glass, subdued cyan/deep teal rims. Almost black material, restrained thin colored edges; much darker than arcade ships and projectiles. Landscape 1536x1024. Bottom-aligned shallow skyline band: baseline at very bottom, silhouettes occupy bottom 55 percent only, clear transparent sky above. Skyline extends across width with low structures at both edges, no giant center landmark or floor strip. No perspective convergence. Genuine alpha background outside structures, NOT opaque black, NOT painted checkerboard. No sky, stars, grid, floor plane, UI, text, logo, watermarks, ships, characters, targets, bullets, pickups, bright white or green/lime lights. No bright scattered dots or wide bloom.
